action.command: ps aux | grep "[n]ext" | awk '{print $2}'; for p in $(ps aux | grep "[n]ext" | awk '{print $2}'); do kill -9 $p 2>/dev/null; done; for p in $(ps aux | grep "[s]tart-server" | awk '{print $2}'); do kill -9 $p 2>/dev/null; done; sleep 2; ps aux | grep "[n]ext" | wc -l; rm -rf /workspace/.next; ls -d /workspace/.next 2>/dev/null || echo "no .next"
